title: Match Guards
goal: Refine pattern matching with extra conditions using match guards.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Morning: Pattern Matching

sections.text: Patterns match on shapes and values. When you need to test a condition beyond the value's shape, use a match guard.

sections.caption: The if condition runs after pattern matching.

sections.text: A match guard adds an `if` expression after the pattern and before the arrow.
If the guard evaluates to `false`, that match arm is skipped and checking continues to the next arm.

sections.caption: If x is odd, the guard fails and falls through.

sections.text: Guards do not count toward exhaustiveness. The compiler cannot verify `if` conditions, so an unguarded catch-all arm is still required. Missing it causes error `E0004`.

explanation: Refine pattern matching with extra conditions using match guards.
